Review remediation record (2026-08-21) — moved out of the ticket description to fit the 8000-char plan-review admission cap.

## Review remediation (2026-08-21)
- Removed `examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/phases/` from Scope and dropped the "dossier template" deliverable: that directory does not exist (the skill ships exactly `SKILL.md`, `test-design.md`, `llm-behavioral-taxonomy.md`) and there is no dossier template — the dossier is prose at `SKILL.md:182-232`.
- Corrected the inverted premise: Step 7 does not "only say to file or link a ticket for each hit" — `SKILL.md:759-762` already mandates "Fix each confirmed sibling under the same RED→GREEN discipline", with ticket-filing as the out-of-scope fallback (same shape at `783-785` for Axis 2).
- Corrected "requires a construct sweep and a parity sweep": `SKILL.md:743-745` states the two axes are independent with independent triggers — enter on *either*, and skip entirely for a one-off single-surface bug.
- Narrowed the claimed new content: `rebar review-plan <id>` before Phase 2, with `file_impact` declared, already exists at `SKILL.md:562-568`. The genuinely new content is siblings-as-AC-checkboxes plus a Step-7 cross-reference to that directive; Step 7 must link rather than duplicate.
- Replaced AC#1: `grep -n "review-plan" examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md` passes today (exit 0, line 564) with zero implementation, and "landing inside Step 7" was prose, not part of the command. Every criterion is now an `awk`-range command scoped to Step 7 that fails on the current tree.
- Removed the `--force` claim: `rebar review-plan --help` defines `--force` as "re-run the review even if a current attestation exists" (and bypassing the not-yet-claimable fast-fail). It does not override a `BLOCK`, so there was nothing to abstain from.
- Relocated and widened the docs edit: `docs/plan-review-gate.md` has no "bug escalation" section, and it actively contradicts the shipped escalation at `:486-489` ("a bug can be coached but never BLOCKED") and `:1348-1353` ("never blocks a bug … `det_blocking:[]` … `route_criteria` returns only `BUG_TIER_CRITERIA`"). A one-sentence addition would have left three contradicting passages standing, so the escalation now lands as a subsection under `## R4` (line 1325) with both passages corrected.
- Added the portability conditioning for Step 7 (`project.portability` is blocking and active per `.rebar/criteria_routing.json`); Step 7 is currently tracker-generic, so bare `rebar` command names would make it rebar-only.
- Named the real consumers in Scope: `scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py` lints `**/SKILL.md` frontmatter only and cannot check Step 7; `tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py:29` pins `test-design.md` byte-identical to the shared copy.
